sections.h2: India has commissioned 200+ of the 5,000 CBG plants it targeted

chart.title: Commissioned CBG plants are a small fraction of the national target
chart.source: Cabinet approval of GOBARdhan, PMO press release, 6 Aug 2026.

sections.means: Over 200 CBG plants were commissioned by 6 August 2026, against a target of 5,000.
sections.todo: Planners should treat the scheme's guaranteed price floor as the basis for new plant investment.

sections.h2: Rocket-grade liquid methane is 99% pure, against 90% under IS 16087

chart.title: Rocket-grade methane sits above the CBG standard's 90% floor
chart.source: BIS IS 16087:2013, Table 1; rocket-grade figure as cited in the article.

sections.means: The methane purity that rocket fuel needs is above the minimum set for city-gas and vehicle biomethane.
sections.todo: Any plant aiming at rocket-grade output should plan an extra liquefaction and purification step beyond CBG grade.

sections.h2: The CNG/PNG blending obligation rises from 3% to 5% by FY2028-29

chart.title: Offtake demand is set to grow as the blending obligation rises to 5%
chart.source: Cabinet approval of GOBARdhan, PMO press release, 6 Aug 2026.

sections.means: The offtake obligation grows each year, giving CBG producers a rising market for vehicle fuel.
sections.todo: Producers should match plant output to the blending schedule before committing to new capacity.
